messages.subject: median_hillow without shading
parts:
Hi all,

I'm trying to produce a plot that summarizes the quantiles (across
simulations) of Relative Error across time for an ecological
quantity. I really like median_hillow:

m <- ggplot(SB.RE, aes(year, RE, colour=factor(sim)))
m + stat_summary(fun.data = "median_hilow", conf.int=.9, geom =
"smooth")

but was wondering if there's a way to create a similar plot that draws
the median trajectory, 90% confidence intervals, but doesn't shade in
the confidence interval, so just the lines for the bounds and the
median.

Any suggestions ?

Thanks.

messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
messages.subject: Re: median_hillow without shading
parts:
Hi Bahama,

Try using geom = "ribbon" and then adjusting fill and colour. You'll
also need another layer which uses geom = "line" to display just the
median.

Hadley
